summary: Tested v3 Invite Studio with per-element drag wrappers, photo mosaic backgrounds, and bg fit/zoom/nudge controls. Backend smoke: 5/5 critical pytest cases pass (health, suggest-text, payment status initial, create checkout session, status after session) — image-gen test deselected (slow, ~30s, not in scope). Frontend: home renders 6 category pills and 8 templates; editor toolbar shows all 6 tools (text/background/color/font/layout/ai) + save-invite-btn; invite-canvas renders with text-title, text-message, and text-meta as independent draggable wrappers and attribution-footer present; panel-layout has 4 mosaic chips and reveals pick-mosaic-btn when a non-single layout is selected; bgfit-cover/contain, all 6 zoom chips (1, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2, 2.5), and nudge up/down/left/right/reset are all present and tappable without crashing; tapping bgfit-contain → bg-zoom-1.5 → nudge-right keeps canvas + title rendered. Regression: font tool still works — font-playfair/font-dm_serif/font-dancing render; tapping font-dancing sets the title fontFamily to DancingScript_700Bold; reset-position-btn is present and tappable. Save flow navigates from /editor to /preview/inv_<id> with locked-banner + pay-btn visible. No JS console errors during the run.

issues: Pre-existing RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow* props, pointerEvents) — cosmetic only, no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: InviteCanvas BackgroundLayer applies transform translateX/Y at (offset * 200) without considering the canvas size or bgFit mode — on 'contain' the image is letterboxed and the translate ends up shifting the letterboxed image relative to its own bounding box, which is visually subtle. Functional, no crash. Consider tying offsets to actual canvas dimensions for a more predictable nudge feel.

When user selects a mosaic layout (e.g. grid_2x2) but provides fewer than 4 photos, BackgroundLayer pads with `four[0] || ''` which can produce <Image source={{uri: ''}}/> entries. Renders a transparent tile (no crash) but may look broken — consider hiding empty tiles or filling with the single `background` fallback.

Per-element Draggable uses PanResponder + Animated.event for live drag. On web this often falls back to mouse events; gesture not exhaustively tested per task instructions (web PanResponder is unreliable from Playwright). testIDs verified — no crash on layout/font/color tool interactions.
Storage key bump to invite-maker:invites:v3 means previously saved v2 invites won't appear — acceptable for this iteration as noted by main agent.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 critical pytest; image-gen deselected as out-of-scope)
